description: MK7873N-82-61-3S is the drawing identifier for timing control device in AutomationDirect's Timers and Sockets collection. A timing control device changes a control output according to its selected timing function. The physical layout must distinguish the device from any separately selected socket or base.

Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.
